repo_type.description: hosted (default), proxy or group. Proxy repositories are supported for maven, deb, rpm and raw; group repositories for maven and raw (deb/rpm groups cannot merge repository metadata). Other combinations are rejected with 400 validation_failed. Proxy and group repositories are read-only.

upstream_url.description: Required for proxy repos. Plain http(s) base URL without credentials, query or fragment; validated against the outbound (SSRF) policy.

member_repos.description: For group repos: ordered member repository names (first hit wins). Members must be hosted or proxy repositories of the group's format; groups cannot be nested.
